name: dentalcarehn.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.dentalcarehn.com scores 65 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 36 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Microsoft Clarity (5 requests).
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 38 elements on /, /tratamientos, /quienes-somos, for example .twJknM.wixui-button[aria-label="Tratamientos"] > .OR4Nv8.wixui-button__label and #comp-ju8aljot > .twJknM.wixui-button[aria-label=" Lee mas"] > .OR4Nv8.wixui-button__label.…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: axios 0.21.4 has known flaws
fix.evidence: axios 0.21.4 (banner of /_partials/wix-thunderbolt/dist/clientWorker.395ab825.bundle.min.js): 24 known flaws, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2023-45857, CVE-2025-27152, CVE-2026-25639. Axios does not correctly normalize hostnames when checking…
fix.fix: Upgrade axios to 1.6.8 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 5 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: A session recorder runs before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Microsoft Clarity sent recording data. Session recorders replay clicks, scrolling, and anything typed into fields they do not mask.
fix.fix: Load the recorder only after consent, and mask every form field in its settings.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 5 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.
